title: Learning Responsibility-Attributed Adversarial Scenarios for Testing Autonomous Vehicles
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety-critical scenario generation and collision attribution for autonomous driving systems (ADSs) using technical and regulatory standards (such as UN ECE R157). While it references 'responsibility' and 'normative' models, these are used as kinematic and legal benchmarks for traffic safety rather than an evaluation of religion, faith, or philosophical/moral reasoning.
